companyContext: Celio (stylised celio*) is a French men's ready-to-wear retailer founded in 1985 and headquartered in Saint-Ouen, near Paris. With more than 1,100 stores across 50+ countries, the brand specialises in accessible, simple and well-cut everyday menswear under its 'be normal*' positioning, and is known for high-profile licensed collaborations (sports, pop culture, motorsport).
brandContext: Capsule collection by celio inspired by McLaren Racing and the McLaren Formula 1 Team (MCL39). The line — jackets, sweats, t-shirts, polos, caps — translates the codes of the F1 paddock into an everyday wardrobe: powerful contrasts, sharp lines, racing typography, checkered-flag motifs and the iconic papaya orange signature, under the campaign tagline 'Born for the track / Prêt à passer en pole position'.

brandVision: Bring the adrenaline, precision and racing heritage of McLaren Formula 1 into celio's 'be normal*' everyday menswear universe — a wardrobe that does not go unnoticed, blending sharp tailoring, motorsport graphics and the iconic papaya orange to dress the modern man from the city to the grandstand.
brandValues: Performance, audacity, accessibility, authenticity, and craftsmanship. celio x McLaren stands for everyday confidence with a competitive edge: high-quality, well-cut pieces at fair prices, infused with the team spirit, speed and bold contrasts of top-tier F1 racing — for real guys, not just fans on the podium.
